checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging.
Root/trunk/branch/twig/leaf hierarchy tooling exists; tree anchors now also receive root-zone planting interfaces rather than remaining visually disconnected from the plaza/grass substrate.

Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present. Cause-based low understory reuses the same thin-leaf optical model and supplies four renderer-distinct cross-faded LOD levels with density reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass deletes the legacy WeatheringOverlays primitive-cube root and reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as non-colliding source-anchored meshes; vegetation density likewise follows ordinary maintenance/foot-traffic pressure rather than random decoration. Park-furniture microtextures are restricted to manufacture-scale structure and explicitly leave macro runoff, splash height, rust juice, UV gradients and contact polish to causal systems.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, dry non-metallic weathering residue materials, root-zone soil/precast tree-pit materials, transmitted-light understory foliage, and eight 1024px park/street-furniture Albedo/Normal/MetallicSmoothness sets. Bare slide stainless/exposed steel are normalized to metallic=1.0 in the final furniture microdetail pass while paint, timber, concrete, backing and diffuser remain dielectric.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing refresh and outdoor BlendProbesAndSkybox renderer policy.

Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics explicitly skips when the danchi authored-art slot is active. Vegetation ecology keys from stable tree-slot anchors, so authored tree replacement does not require moving the surrounding root-zone interface.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with explicit foundation/grade, facade/glazing, environment, facade-weathering, vegetation-ecology and park/street-furniture contracts. The furniture microdetail contract records manufacture, finish, physical tile scale, roughness, metallic/specular class, normal amplitude/scale, wetness, UV aging, angular/Fresnel response, geometry-vs-material split, causal separation and an exact lookdev generation brief.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before capture. Scene-save gates make non-primitive facade weathering, vegetation ecology and manufactured park/street furniture with physical-profile/LOD/microdetail QA persisted invariants whenever detailed ground exists. The final scene reopen re-validates lighting and refreshes realtime probes immediately before capture.

Capture contract records exact view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it. Park-furniture microdetail additionally requires actual close crops for stainless abrasion, timber grain, concrete/contact transition and painted-vs-bare-metal response before any visual credit.
No actual Unity 6.3 editor/runner compile verification artifact exists yet.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Material/PBR physical plausibility: the slide chute and exposed hardware are normalized to fully metallic final surfaces, while paint/timber/concrete/backing/diffuser remain dielectric; roughness variation is material-specific rather than one scalar per object.

Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: furniture gains physical-scale 1024px manufacture microstructure with metric UV handling, including directional slide abrasion, lengthwise timber grain, coating orange-peel, precast aggregate/pinholes and diffuser frost.

Geometry/construction fidelity: the material pass explicitly preserves real 2 mm chute-shell geometry, real slat gaps, pole/profile construction and fasteners rather than baking those cues into textures.
Lighting/reflections: stainless micro-roughness is designed to modulate actual sky/probe reflection under frontal/oblique/grazing views instead of painting a white streak into albedo.
Temporal/LOD stability: all generated microtextures use mipmaps, trilinear filtering and anisotropy 12; actual shimmer still requires runtime motion evidence.
